comparison.objective: Lift and place a rabbit while continuously supporting its back; candidate commissions an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated whole-body bimanual support and transport versus fine tool use, rotary adjustment, counterhold, and guarded machine cycling.
comparison.success_condition: No spine bend over 25° or fall of 3 cm, then place in carrier versus two repeatable safe stops with no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Animal-support manipulation is unrelated to damper commissioning.
